title: rescue needed 🐕
description:
A heartbreaking scene of a weak and injured stray dog ​​lying motionless on the roadside. The brown mixed-breed dog appears exhausted and possibly wounded, with visible signs of illness or injury, evoking compassion for homeless animals struggling on the streets. This image highlights the plight of stray dogs and the urgent need for animal rescue and care in urban areas.
